findings.description: On checkout step one, the Last Name field is bound to the First Name value: typing a last name overwrites the first name and the last name field stays empty, so Continue is blocked with 'Last Name is required' and the customer cannot reach the overview or finish an order.
repro: Add any product to the cart and click Checkout
Observe First Name now shows 'Lee' and Last Name is empty
Enter a postal code and click Continue
Observe error 'Error: Last Name is required' and the page stays on step one

findings.description: Sorting by price (low to high or high to low) does not work: after selecting either price option the dropdown snaps back to 'Name (A to Z)' and the product list stays in the default order (29.99, 9.99, 15.99, 49.99, 7.99, 15.99). Name sorting works.
repro: On the products page open the sort dropdown
Observe the dropdown returns to 'Name (A to Z)' and prices are not ordered ascending
Select 'Price (high to low)' and observe the same reset

notes: Tested login, product list, name sorting, add to cart, cart view and checkout step one. Could not reach checkout overview or order completion because of f1, so totals, tax and completion were not verified. Time budget was short; permission, security-hygiene, perf and visual categories were only lightly checked (no issues seen on the pages visited).
